GroupPermissions.AccessUpdated: The group '%1$s' now has the role '%3$s' for '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.AddAutoAccessRule: Give this group access to new websites matching
GroupPermissions.AddExternalGroup: Map an external group to this group
GroupPermissions.AddUserToGroup: Add a new member to this group
GroupPermissions.AllWebsitesNote: "Apply to all websites" changes the role of a group for every website you administer. The current roles of the groups are not shown in this view.
GroupPermissions.ApplyAutoAccessRuleConfirm: Apply the rule '%1$s' to all existing websites? The group '%2$s' gets the role '%3$s' (and the capabilities of the rule) for every matching website, unless it already has a higher role.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessCapabilitiesHelp: Optional: capabilities the group gets in addition to the role.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessDescription: Rules give this group a role for every website created from now on that is in a matching website group or has a matching URL (main URL or alias URL). Existing websites are only changed when you apply a rule to them.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessRuleAdded: The rule has been added. It applies to websites created from now on.
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessRuleApplied: The rule has been applied to %s website(s).
GroupPermissions.AutoAccessRuleRemoved: The rule has been removed. Access already given by it is kept.
GroupPermissions.CapabilityAdded: The group '%1$s' now has the capability '%2$s' for '%3$s'.
GroupPermissions.CapabilityRemoved: The capability '%2$s' has been removed from the group '%1$s' for '%3$s'.
GroupPermissions.ChangeAccessToAllSitesConfirm: Are you sure you want to give '%s' access to the group '%s' for all the websites?
GroupPermissions.CopyReport: Copy a report to the members of this group
GroupPermissions.DashboardCopiedToGroup: Dashboard copied to %1$s member(s) of the group '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.DeleteGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the group '%s'?
GroupPermissions.DeleteGroupDescription: Deleting a group removes the access its members got through it. The users themselves are not deleted.
GroupPermissions.DescriptionAccessTab: Decide which groups have access to your websites. You can also give access to all the websites at once by choosing "Apply to all websites" in the website selector.
GroupPermissions.DescriptionGroupsTab: Create groups, add users to them and give the groups access to websites. Every member gets the access of all their groups (the highest role wins).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionAnonymousNotAllowed: The anonymous user cannot be added to a group.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionEmptyExternalGroup: Please enter the name or DN of an external group.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionEmptyOidcGroupsClaim: Please enter the name of the groups claim.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionEmptyPattern: Please enter a website group or URL.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionEmptySamlGroupsAttribute: Please enter the name of the group attribute.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionExternalGroupDoesExist: The external group '%s' is already mapped to this group.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionExternalGroupDoesNotExist: The external group '%s' is not mapped to this group.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionExternalGroupTooLong: The external group is too long (at most %s characters).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionGroupNameTooLong: The group name is too long (at most %s characters, special characters like quotes count as several characters).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionGroupsAdminDisabled: Changing groups and their members and access has been disabled (enable_groups_admin in the [GroupPermissions] section of the config file).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionInvalidExternalGroups: The external groups must be a list of group names.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionInvalidLdapAttribute: The group membership attribute may only contain letters, digits, hyphens and semicolons.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionInvalidLdapFilter: The group search filter must be enclosed in parentheses, e.g. (member=?).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionInvalidMatchType: The match type must be one of: %1$s. Given: %2$s
GroupPermissions.ExceptionInviteCancelled: The invitation of %1$s was cancelled because the user could not be added to the groups: %2$s The invitation email that was already sent is no longer valid.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionNoCapabilitiesWithoutRole: The group '%1$s' needs a role for the website with ID %2$s before it can get capabilities.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionNoGroupSelected: Please select at least one group.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionPatternTooLong: The pattern is too long (at most %s characters).
GroupPermissions.ExceptionReportNotFound: The scheduled report %s does not exist or you are not allowed to copy it. You can only copy reports you created yourself.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionReportSegmentNotCopyable: The report uses a segment that is not shared with all users. Members can only use their own segments and segments shared with all users in their reports, so the report cannot be copied. Choose such a segment for the report or remove the segment.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionReportTypeNotCopyable: Only email reports can be copied to groups.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionRuleDoesExist: This group already has a rule with this pattern.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionSegmentGroupWithoutAccess: The group %s has no access to the website of the segment. You can only share segments with groups that have a role for the website of the segment, or, for segments of all websites, for a website you administer.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionSegmentNotFound: The segment %s does not exist or you are not allowed to share it. You can only share segments you created yourself.
GroupPermissions.ExceptionUserNotInGroup: User %s is not in the group
GroupPermissions.ExternalGroupAdded: Users in the external group '%1$s' now become members of the group '%2$s' on their next sync.
GroupPermissions.ExternalGroupRemoved: The external group '%1$s' is no longer mapped to the group '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.GiveAccess: Give this group access to a website
GroupPermissions.GroupNameHelp: For example the name of a team or department.
GroupPermissions.GroupRenamed: The group has been renamed to '%s'.
GroupPermissions.GroupSyncDescription: Users in one of these external groups automatically become members of this group when their groups are synchronized: when they log in via LDAP, OpenID Connect or SAML (if enabled in the general settings), when another login plugin triggers the sync, or via the API method GroupPermissions.syncUserGroups. Members added by the sync are removed again when they are no longer in a mapped group; members added manually are kept.
GroupPermissions.GroupSyncHelpNames: Enter the name of the group as sent by the identity provider (e.g. the value of the groups claim or SAML attribute), or the distinguished name of an LDAP group. Names are case-insensitive. A plain name like Matomo Admins also matches LDAP groups with this first value (e.g. CN=Matomo Admins,OU=Groups,DC=example,DC=com), a DN only matches that exact DN.
GroupPermissions.GroupSyncPlainNameWarning: %1$s: names without a distinguished name also match every LDAP group whose first value is this name, in any part of the directory (e.g. both CN=Admins,OU=Staff,... and CN=Admins,OU=Contractors,...). Users in any of these LDAP groups become members. If you sync from LDAP, map the full distinguished name instead.
GroupPermissions.IncludedInGroupRole: included in the role of the group
GroupPermissions.InviteUser: Invite a new user to groups
GroupPermissions.InviteUserDescription: Invite a new user by email and add them directly to the selected groups. The user gets access to websites through these groups only.
GroupPermissions.InviteUserIntoGroup: Invite a new user into this group
GroupPermissions.InviteUserNoWebsiteWarning: None of the selected groups has access to a website yet. Matomo requires a website for the invitation, so the invitation email will name another website, which the user will not have access to.
GroupPermissions.InviteUserSuccess: The user '%s' has been invited and added to the selected groups.
GroupPermissions.MemberAdded: '%s' has been added to the group.
GroupPermissions.MemberRemoved: '%s' has been removed from the group.
GroupPermissions.NoAutoAccessRules: This group does not get access to new websites automatically.
GroupPermissions.NoCopyableReports: There are no email reports to copy.
GroupPermissions.NoExternalGroups: No external groups are mapped to this group yet.
GroupPermissions.NoGroups: There are no groups yet. Create a group to manage the access of several users at once.
GroupPermissions.NoMembers: This group has no members yet.
GroupPermissions.NoSharedSegments: No segments are shared with this group yet.
GroupPermissions.NoWebsiteAccess: This group has no access to any website yet.
GroupPermissions.PatternHelpSiteGroup: Name of the website group (case-insensitive), * matches any characters.
GroupPermissions.PatternHelpUrl: Host of the website URL, e.g. *.example.com, or host and path, e.g. example.com/shop*. Case-insensitive, * matches any characters.
GroupPermissions.RemoveAccessConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the access of the group '%1$s' to '%2$s'?
GroupPermissions.RemoveAutoAccessRuleConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the rule '%s'? Access already given by it is kept.
GroupPermissions.RemoveCapabilityConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the capability '%1$s' from the group '%2$s' for '%3$s'?
GroupPermissions.RemoveExternalGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the mapping of the external group '%1$s' to the group '%2$s'? Members added by the sync keep their membership until their next sync.
GroupPermissions.RemoveFromGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove user '%1$s' from group '%2$s'?
GroupPermissions.RenameGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to rename the group '%1$s' to '%2$s'?
GroupPermissions.ReportCopied: The report '%1$s' was copied to %2$s member(s) of the group '%3$s'.
GroupPermissions.ScheduledReportsDescription: Copy an email report to the members of this group: every member with access to the website of the report gets a copy of their own, which they can change, send or delete like their own reports. The copies are sent to their member only ("Send report to me"); the other recipients of the report are not copied. Later changes of the report are not applied to the copies.
GroupPermissions.SegmentShared: The segment '%1$s' is now shared with the group '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.SegmentUnshared: The segment '%1$s' is no longer shared with the group '%2$s'.
GroupPermissions.SegmentsDescription: Members of this group see the segments shared with it in the segment selector, as long as they have access to the website of the segment. Only the creator of a segment and super users can edit it. Segments shared with all users are not listed.
GroupPermissions.SelectRoleForAllWebsites: Select a role for all websites
GroupPermissions.SettingLdapGroupAttributeHelp: Attribute of the LDAP user entry listing the groups of the user, e.g. memberOf (Active Directory, OpenLDAP with the memberOf overlay). Leave empty to only use the group search filter.
GroupPermissions.SettingLdapGroupBaseDnHelp: Base DN for the group search filter. Leave empty to use the base DN of the LDAP server.
GroupPermissions.SettingLdapGroupFilterHelp: Optional LDAP filter finding the groups of the user, ? is replaced by the DN of the user, e.g. %s. Use it for directories without a membership attribute on the user entry.
GroupPermissions.SettingLdapGroupSync: Synchronize group memberships from LDAP groups
GroupPermissions.SettingLdapGroupSyncHelp: When an LDAP user logs in with their password, they become a member of every group mapped to one of their LDAP groups (see "Directory sync" in the group editor) and are removed from groups an earlier sync added them to but that no longer match. Memberships added manually are kept. Uses the LDAP servers configured for the LoginLdap plugin.
GroupPermissions.SettingOidcGroupSync: Synchronize group memberships from OpenID Connect groups
GroupPermissions.SettingOidcGroupSyncHelp: When a user logs in through LoginOIDC or RebelOIDC, they become a member of every group mapped to one of the groups in their ID token (see "Directory sync" in the group editor) and are removed from groups an earlier sync added them to but that no longer match. Memberships added manually are kept. The provider must include the groups in the ID token.
GroupPermissions.SettingOidcGroupsClaimHelp: Claim of the ID token listing the groups of the user, e.g. groups (Keycloak with a group membership mapper, Microsoft Entra ID, Authentik), a namespaced claim like https://example.com/groups (Auth0), or a path into nested claims like realm_access.roles or resource_access.matomo.roles (Keycloak roles).
GroupPermissions.SettingSamlGroupSync: Synchronize group memberships from SAML groups
GroupPermissions.SettingSamlGroupSyncHelp: When a user logs in through LoginSaml, they become a member of every group mapped to one of the values of their group attribute in the SAML response (see "Directory sync" in the group editor) and are removed from groups an earlier sync added them to but that no longer match. Memberships added manually are kept.
GroupPermissions.SettingSamlGroupsAttributeHelp: SAML attribute listing the groups of the user (its Name, or its FriendlyName if LoginSaml is configured to use friendly names), e.g. groups, memberOf, http://schemas.microsoft.com/ws/2008/06/identity/claims/groups (Microsoft Entra ID, sends group object IDs) or http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/claims/Group (AD FS).
GroupPermissions.ShareSegment: Share a segment with this group
GroupPermissions.SiteFormGroupAccessHelp: Roles of the groups for this website. Members of a group get its role. Groups that are not listed have no access through groups. Groups can also get access automatically with the rules in the group editor.
GroupPermissions.SyncedMemberHelp: Added by the directory sync, removed again when the user is no longer in a mapped external group. Add the user to the group manually to keep the membership.
GroupPermissions.UnshareSegmentConfirm: Are you sure you want to stop sharing the segment '%1$s' with the group '%2$s'?
